newsitem.title: USA: U. Mich consumer sentiment 103.4 June preliminary.
newsitem.headline: U. Mich consumer sentiment 103.4 June preliminary.

text.p: The University of Michigan's preliminary index of consumer sentiment for June rose to 103.4 compared to 103.2 in the final May index, financial market sources said on Friday.

The current conditions component remained unchanged in the preliminary June report at the 113.5 reading in the final May. The expectations index rose to 96.9 in the June preliminary data versus 96.6 in the final May.
The data are released only to paying subscribers.
